topics.title_zh: OpenAI估值下调至1.25万亿，三员工因泄密被解雇
topics.title_en: OpenAI Valuation Cut to $1.25T Amid Three Staff Firings for Leaks
topics.summary_zh: OpenAI在拟议的300亿美元融资中，受制于投资人抵触，将投前估值从1.4万亿下调至1.25万亿美元。同时，公司内部爆出解雇丑闻，三名安全研究人员被指控通过阅后即焚聊天泄露核心模型设计，引发了对公司治理与技术保密体系的强烈关注。
topics.summary_en: OpenAI has lowered its valuation target to $1.25T from $1.4T amid investor pushback on an impending $30B funding round. Simultaneously, three researchers were fired for allegedly leaking proprietary model designs via disappearing Signal chats, triggering deep concerns over internal governance and intellectual property security.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: OpenAI 管理层及核心融资方
perspective_pro.point_zh: 通过激进融资获取算力资源是实现AGI的唯一路径。内部人员的严苛清理是维护核心技术护城河的必要手段。
perspective_pro.point_en: Aggressive fundraising is the only path to the massive compute needed for AGI; strict internal purge is a necessary defense of their proprietary moat.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 硅谷分析师与安全审计专家
perspective_con.point_zh: 估值回调揭示了资本市场对昂贵模型研发ROI的担忧，而频发的泄密事件暗示了企业文化在高速扩张下的极度不稳定性。
perspective_con.point_en: Valuation cuts reflect market fatigue with exorbitant R&D costs, while persistent leaks reveal severe structural instability in the company’s internal culture.

linked_news.title_zh: OpenAI疑机密外泄解雇三名员工
linked_news.title_en: OpenAI suspected the three fired researchers of leaking internal model designs to AI safety researcher Ryan Greenblatt, including via disappearing Signal chats (Wall Street Journal)

linked_news.title_zh: 头部人工智能巨头因投资人抵触下调估值预期
linked_news.title_en: Sources: OpenAI has cut its valuation target to $1.25T, down from the $1.4T valuation it pitched earlier this month, after facing resistance from some investors (Financial Times)

linked_news.title_zh: 资料来源：OpenAI接近由阿联酋和法国投资者领投的300亿美元融资，投前估值为1.25亿美元，这是首次公开募股前的“机会主义”桥梁
linked_news.title_en: Sources: OpenAI nears an up to $30B round led by investors from the UAE and Coatue at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, as an "opportunistic" bridge ahead of an IPO (Kate Rooney/CNBC)

topics.title_zh: SK Hyper拟投3500亿建15GW中心，德国效仿核电改算力
topics.title_en: SK Hyper to Spend $350B on 15GW Data Centers; Germany Eyes Nuclear Re-purposing
topics.summary_zh: 算力基建进入超大规模阶段，SK Hyper计划于2035年前在韩斥资3500亿美元建设15GW数据中心。与此同时，英伟达携手德国能源巨头PreussenElektra开展可行性评估，探讨将退役核电站转化为算力中心的可行性，能源供给正取代芯片产量成为AI发展的核心瓶颈。
topics.summary_en: Compute infrastructure is scaling to record levels as SK Hyper plans $350B for 15GW capacity by 2035. Simultaneously, Nvidia is collaborating with PreussenElektra to assess converting idle German nuclear plants into data centers, highlighting energy as the new critical constraint over chip availability.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 能源基础设施建设商与算力运营商
perspective_pro.point_zh: AI革命本质上是电力革命。利用闲置工业设施和超大规模投资是解决万亿参数模型能耗焦虑的唯一生存策略。
perspective_pro.point_en: The AI revolution is fundamentally an energy revolution. Utilizing idle industrial assets and massive CAPEX is the only strategy to mitigate power constraints.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 绿色能源组织与电力行业智库
perspective_con.point_zh: 将核电设施转化为算力中心面临极高的改造安全合规成本，这种非理性的算力狂热可能导致局部电网系统的灾难性失衡。
perspective_con.point_en: Repurposing nuclear facilities presents insurmountable compliance and engineering costs; this irrational compute fervor risks destabilizing regional power grids.

linked_news.title_en: SK Telecom unit SK Hyper is in talks with tech firms and investors to finance 15GW of data center capacity in South Korea by 2035; the first 5GW will cost $350B (Bloomberg)

linked_news.title_zh: 英伟达携德企评估闲置核电改算力
linked_news.title_en: German energy company PreussenElektra says it is working with Nvidia to assess whether the country's idle nuclear plants could be turned into data centers (Eva Brendel/Bloomberg)

topics.title_zh: Canva推出自研图像模型Craft，重构设计工作流
topics.title_en: Canva Launches Self-Developed Craft Model to Redesign Workflow
topics.summary_zh: 设计平台Canva发布自研图像生成模型Craft，不同于通用大模型，Craft采用两阶段架构：先规划版面布局，再生成图像。此举旨在降低用户设计门槛，通过将AI深度植入垂直工具链，直接挑战了OpenAI及Midjourney在专业设计领域的市场垄断地位。
topics.summary_en: Design platform Canva has introduced Craft, a proprietary image generation model. Unlike general-purpose models, Craft utilizes a two-stage architecture that plans layouts before image rendering, aiming to lower design barriers and challenge incumbents like OpenAI and Midjourney by embedding AI directly into vertical workflows.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 通用模型无法满足设计界对版面逻辑的高精度要求。自研模型能实现语义与空间布局的协同，真正实现从创意到交付的闭环。
perspective_pro.point_en: General-purpose models fail to respect design constraints. Proprietary models that bridge semantic logic and spatial layout are the only way to close the loop.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 大型多模态模型实验室研究员
perspective_con.point_zh: 缺乏海量底座数据支撑的垂直模型，往往会陷入‘过拟合’怪圈，无法具备跨场景的通用泛化与推理扩展能力。
perspective_con.point_en: Vertical models lacking massive, diverse pre-training data often suffer from 'overfitting' and fail to provide the reasoning capabilities of foundation models.

linked_news.title_en: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them

linked_news.title_zh: Canva launches Craft, its first image generation model, trained on human-designed templates, available to all users, with plans to support third-party chatbots
linked_news.title_en: Canva launches Craft, its first image generation model, trained on human-designed templates, available to all users, with plans to support third-party chatbots (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
